purpose: Prevent a Paper-IV terminal decision, especially NEW_REQUIRED, from being inferred from a benchmark set that omits materially distinct major quantum-gravity schools or silently lets one scoped submodel stand for an entire school.

coverage_basis.primary_reference: Bambi, Modesto, Shapiro (eds.), Handbook of Quantum Gravity, Springer 2024, DOI 10.1007/978-981-99-7681-2

tier1_required_rows.name: General Relativity plus controlled low-energy gravitational EFT
Perturbative renormalizable / higher-derivative quantum gravity
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Iter187 closes the major action-level pole/prescription fork map, but family closure still requires terminal disposition of the materially distinct quantization branches plus one fixed-branch same-realization unitarity/causality-or-controlled-nonlocality/normalized-observable/full-comparator package.

tier1_required_rows.name: Hořava-Lifshitz quantum gravity
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Freeze a projectable UV trajectory through the IR GR/extra-mode regime with a normalized observable and comparator, and separately disposition the materially distinct non-projectable theory.

tier1_required_rows.name: Nonlocal / infinite-derivative quantum gravity
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Resolve cross-order/full-momentum functional rigidity and materially independent loop/non-scattering/form-factor branches, then provide family-level exhaustion/equivalence authority.

tier1_required_rows.name: String / M-theory / holographic quantum gravity
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Supply a material subfamily map and family-level equivalence/exhaustion certificate; dual-resonance rigidity is only a scoped child result.

tier1_required_rows.name: Causal Set quantum gravity
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Freeze a fundamental dynamics/measure to emergent manifold regime plus a normalized genuinely causal-set gravitational observable and same-domain comparator.

tier1_required_rows.name: Causal/Euclidean Dynamical Triangulations
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Freeze a 4D continuum/RG trajectory, lattice-spacing map and invariant physical observable with finite-size/discretization/systematic errors and identical-domain comparators.

tier1_required_rows.name: Group Field Theory / tensor models
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Derive or refute an explicit reduction/equivalence map to spinfoams; if independent, freeze a full gravity observable/comparator outside condensate-state cosmology.

tier1_required_rows.name: Noncommutative spectral geometry / spectral-action gravity
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Freeze a genuine quantum dynamics/measure for the spectral data plus a normalized quantum-gravity observable, error ledger and same-domain comparator beyond the classical/asymptotic spectral action.

tier1_required_rows.name: Canonical Wheeler-DeWitt geometrodynamics
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Freeze Hamiltonian/constraint realization, physical inner product, relational clock, anomaly/constraint closure, normalized Dirac observable, semiclassical GR map and comparator.

tier1_required_rows.name: Quantum Graphity / explicit dynamical-graph geometrogenesis
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Freeze a connected low-energy phase with continuum Lorentzian spin-2/GR emergence and a normalized physical observable plus same-domain comparators.

tier1_required_rows.name: Relational Quantum Causal Processes / RQCP-QG
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Promote the reproducible fixed-band same-family Einstein-response control to one all-band background-independent autonomous gravity parent, including dynamically selected adjacency/time/volume/dimension/signature or an explicit equivalent construction, a quantum metric Hilbert space or equivalent gravity-state structure, anomaly-free quantum constraint/BV-BRST closure, topology/black-hole control, normalized operational gravity observables, same-domain comparators and propagated errors. In addition, close the independent local oscillator Hilbert-cutoff/domain axis either by controlled cutoff removal/convergence with propagated observable errors or by an autonomous physical selection principle for the finite cutoff/domain with its induced observable uncertainty.

reduction_map: Einstein/supergravity output -> GR_EFT or STRING_MTHEORY_HOLOGRAPHY according to UV ancestry
higher-derivative output -> PERTURBATIVE_HIGHER_DERIVATIVE or STRING_MTHEORY_HOLOGRAPHY according to ancestry

tier2_resolution_watchlist.promotion_rule: Every concrete proposal with an explicit independent quantum parent, gravity/emergence claim and materially distinct observables is promoted to Tier1; generic adjectives do not count as tested theories.

A concrete independent quantum parent with gravity/emergence claims and materially distinct observables is not omitted merely because it postdates the original framework census; absent an explicit reduction map it receives its own nonterminal Tier1 row.
